name: projecttaskmanager
description: A production-minded, full-stack application for managing engineering projects and their associated work items (tasks). Built with an **ASP.NET Core 9** Web API backend, **Entity Framework Core 9 (Code First)**, **SQL Server**, and a modern **React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS** frontend.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,CLIENT -c blue,green "dotnet run --project src/ProjectTaskManager.Api" "npm run dev --prefix client"
